localBiteReport: The most current readable reports for Choctawhatchee Bay are from the past 1–2 weeks. A recent angler report on FishingBooker noted two solid redfish caught by working bait under the bridge and in deep water past the bay. A guide posting on CaptainExperiences (Freeport/Destin area, approximately one week ago) noted generally good fishing with live bait early in the mornings and soft plastics throughout the day, though quality fish have been slightly slower. Half Hitch (halfhitch.com) has published a Destin report dated November 16, 2026, but its full body content was not accessible via search — however, their November seasonal forecast consistently highlights this time of year as prime for flounder, redfish, and speckled trout in the bay, with rat reds hanging around docks and bridges, trout on the flats, and sheepshead building around bridge pilings and jetties. Water temperature at the bay is 70°F as of today.
